with spine as (

    select 
        dateadd(day, row_number() over (order by seq4()) -1, to_date('2024-01-01')) as date_day
    from table(generator(rowcount => 1827))

) 

select
    to_number(to_char(date_day, 'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,
    date_day,
    year(date_day) as calendar_year,
    quarter(date_day) as calendar_quarter,
    month(date_day) as calendar_month,
    monthname(date_day) as month_name,
    day(date_day) as day_of_month,
    dayofweekiso(date_day) as day_of_week_iso,
    dayname(date_day) as day_name,
    weekofyear(date_day) as week_of_year,
    dayofweekiso(date_day) in (6,7) as is_weekend

from spine

-- Incremental on the Fivetran watermark. ">=" re-reads the latest batch on
-- every run, which is safe because the merge on transaction_id is idempotent.
-- Soft-deleted rows stay in the table with is_deleted = true.

with txn as (

    select * from DB_BANKING.STAGING.stg_transactions
    
        where fivetran_synced_at >= (
            select coalesce(max(fivetran_synced_at), to_timestamp_tz('1990-01-01 00:00:00')) from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions
        )
        or transaction_id in (
            select transaction_id from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions
            where account_key is null or customer_key is null
        )  
    
    
),

acct as (

    select account_key, account_id, customer_id, valid_from, valid_to
    from DB_BANKING.MARTS.dim_account
    
),

cust as (

    select customer_key, customer_id, valid_from, valid_to
    from DB_BANKING.MARTS.dim_customer

),

merch as (

    select merchant_key, merchant_id
    from DB_BANKING.MARTS.dim_merchant

)

select 
    t.transaction_id,
    a.account_key,
    c.customer_key,
    m.merchant_key,
    to_number(to_char(cast(t.transaction_ts as date), 'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,
    t.transaction_type,
    t.status,
    t.amount,
    t.currency,
    t.status = 'COMPLETED' as is_completed,
    t.status = 'FAILED' as is_failed,
    t.transaction_ts,
    t.created_at,
    t.updated_at,
    t.fivetran_synced_at,
    t.is_deleted
from txn t 
left join acct a 
    on a.account_id = t.account_id
    and t.transaction_ts >= a.valid_from
    and t.transaction_ts < a.valid_to
left join cust c
    on c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    and t.transaction_ts >= c.valid_from
    and t.transaction_ts < c.valid_to
left join merch m
    on m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id

-- one row per minute, for the live trend chart

select

    date_trunc('minute', transaction_ts) as minute_ts,
    count(*) as txn_count,
    sum(amount) as total_amount

from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions
where not is_deleted
group by 1

-- failed-transaction rate per hour

select 

    date_trunc('hour', transaction_ts) as hour_ts,
    count(*) as txn_count,
    count_if(is_failed) as failed_count,
    div0(count_if(is_failed), count(*)) as failed_rate

from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions
where not is_deleted
group by 1

-- one row per day, for the KPI tiles

select

    cast(transaction_ts as date) as txn_date,
    count(*) as txn_count,
    count_if(is_completed) as completed_count,
    count_if(is_failed) as failed_count,
    div0(count_if(is_completed), count(*)) as success_rate,
    sum(case when is_completed then amount end) as completed_amount,
    avg(case when is_completed then amount end) as avg_ticket_size

from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions
where not is_deleted
group by 1

-- merchants ranked by completed value

with totals as (

    select
    
        m.merchant_key,
        m.merchant_id,
        m.merchant_name,
        m.category,
        count(*) as completed_txn_count,
        sum(f.amount) as completed_amount
        
    from DB_BANKING.MARTS.fct_transactions f
    join DB_BANKING.MARTS.dim_merchant m
        on m.merchant_key = f.merchant_key
    where not f.is_deleted and f.is_completed
    group by 1,2,3,4
)

select
    *,
    rank() over (order by completed_amount desc) as merchant_rank
from totals
